content: rate_limits.five_hour and seven_day (used_percentage 0-100, resets_at epoch seconds) ship on stdin since Claude Code v2.1+ for Claude.ai Pro/Max subscribers; appear only after first API response; absent on API-key auth. Model-specific weekly windows (seven_day_opus / seven_day_sonnet style, i.e. the Fable/Opus-specific weekly limit) are NOT on stdin — only via the undocumented OAuth endpoint /api/oauth/usage using tokens from ~/.claude/.credentials.json; community scripts (ohugonnot/claude-code-statusline) cache the API response to a JSON file with file locking and a ~300s TTL, with graceful fallback when unreachable. One guide calls the OAuth approach deprecated/fragile.
